description: 自転車走行空間について [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都建設局. 【東京都建設局】都内の自転車推奨ルート及び、東京都自転車走行空間整備推進計画に基づく優先整備区間. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都建設局. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
